caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, decorative wooden crest with elaborate scrollwork and floral motifs, predominantly in shades of reddish-brown that mimic the natural appearance of polished wood grain. The central feature is a raised, oval medallion surrounded by symmetrical, curling acanthus leaves extending outward on both sides, creating a balanced composition. On each side of the medallion, the scrolls spiral outward and downward, merging with additional curved foliage and flowers that are intricately detailed. Below the elaborate crest is a horizontal wooden base with three layers of molding, each with distinct edges and highlights, also rendered in reddish-brown wood tones. The entire object is set against a plain, light beige background, with a thin red border framing the image.
title: Headboard
